messages:
sara: quick flag 1 eu1 tiltwatch canary showing synthetic failures after the push. p95 jump and intermittent 503s from the smoke probe. @david @min can you take a look?

david: which canary and deployment id? I'll pull the synth logs.

sara: deployment=tiltwatch-v2, canary-tag=2026-03-23-eu1. curl repro: ```curl -s -X POST https://eu1.tiltwatch.service/smoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' -w "
HTTP:%{http_code}
"``` -> HTTP:503, body: {"error":"upstream_unavailable"}.

min: synthetic dashboard correlates spike ~40s post-deploy. traces show gateway throwing 502/503s and inference-proxy latency tail. grabbing proxy logs now.

deploy-bot: rollout event: tiltwatch-v2 -> eu1 canary=10% at 1840000060. initial health ok.

david: proxy logs show repeated 504s upstream and messages: "kvcache: warmup in progress, delaying ready". seems warmstart is delaying backend readiness and causing connect timeouts.

sara: idea: pause rollout and pin eu1 back to tiltwatch-v1 while we root cause. prefer pin vs full rollback for speed.

min: +1. plan: stop further canary increments, route canary traffic to v1, and temporarily scale down v2 replicas in eu1 to avoid further warmstarts. also try repro with warmstart disabled.

ops-bot: incident created: INC-7841 "tiltwatch eu1 canary warmstart 503s" assigned to david, min.

david: applying route pin to tiltwatch-v1 for eu1 now (canary traffic -> stable). ETA ~90s.

sara: lowering smoke timeout threshold so we get earlier signals while debugging. adding note to release: "eu1 tiltwatch-v2 canary paused due to warmstart-induced synthetic failures."

min: starting local repro: spin up tiltwatch-v2 with kvcache bypass and run warmstart job. will post kernel selection logs and trace timeline. suspect quantized kernel fallback path in the new weights.

david: pin applied, traffic switched to v1. smoke probe back to green. good immediate mitigation.

sara: don't do a full rollback yet. keep pin in place until we have repro + mitigation. update the deploy ticket with pin and next steps.

ops-bot: checklist reminder: follow release pinning runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/release-pins.

min: posting repro notes in ~25m. leaving thread open for handoff to infra for any kernel/quant changes.

sara: thanks — CC product & CS for visibility in release notes.
